name: Grade 9 IT Practice: May Week 13 - Archive
description: Practice words for Grade 9 first-trimester physical computing work.

words.definition: To store files neatly for later.
words.example: The student moved the final code and photos into the project archive.

words.definition: Work completed later because it was missed.
words.example: The make-up task let the student submit missing test evidence.

words.definition: Screenshots, photos, code, logs, and files that prove project completion.
words.example: The evidence folder included screenshots, photos, and the final sketch.

words.definition: Teacher or peer comments used to complete the archived project evidence.
words.example: The student used teacher feedback to fix one missing explanation.

words.definition: Class tasks for organization, records, or exams.
words.example: The admin task was renaming files before final submission.

words.definition: An ability you can practice and improve.
words.example: The reflection named debugging as the strongest skill practiced.
